_comment: Twenty made-up sample profiles (10 men, 10 women) for local and staging use only. They are not real people. Each has an illustrated avatar built by scripts/build_avatars.py. scripts/build_sample_seed.py turns this file into seed/sample-profiles.sql. Never load the SQL into the live database.

profiles.training: Strength training four mornings a week, plus a long run on Sundays.
profiles.about: I help people get strong for a living, so I try to practise what I preach. Mornings are for the gym, weekends are for the beach and a long coffee. I cook a decent curry and I'm always up for a walk along the river.
profiles.looking_for: Someone kind and curious who likes being active. Early starts are a bonus, but not a requirement.
profiles.look: a smiling man with short dark hair, in a blue tank top

profiles.training: Full body lifting three nights a week, and indoor climbing on Saturdays.
profiles.about: I spend my days at a desk, so the gym is where I get my head clear. I'm learning to cook properly and I'm very average at climbing, but I keep showing up. Good with a playlist, better with a spotter.
profiles.looking_for: Someone easy to talk to who doesn't take life too seriously. Happy to start with a coffee and see how it goes.
profiles.look: a smiling man with dark curly hair, in a teal tank top

profiles.training: Push, pull, legs, six days a week. Rest day is for the barbecue.
profiles.about: Steady, reliable and usually covered in sawdust or chalk. I train hard, eat well and call my mum every Sunday. I'd like to build a life with someone, not just a weekend plan.
profiles.looking_for: A partner who wants the same things: a home, a dog and a standing Sunday roast. Warm, honest and a bit stubborn is perfect.
profiles.look: a smiling man with a beard and short brown hair, in an olive tank top

profiles.training: Calisthenics and kettlebells before my shift.
profiles.about: I make your coffee in the morning and train people in the afternoon. Pull-ups are my favourite thing and I'll talk about them for too long. I'm new to the city and keen to meet people.
profiles.looking_for: Someone fun who's happy to try a new cafe or a new class. Friends first is completely fine with me.
profiles.look: a smiling man with wavy light brown hair, in an orange top

profiles.training: Heavy compound lifts, then the sauna.
profiles.about: Shift work means my gym hours are all over the place, but I make them count. I'm calm under pressure and terrible at sitting still. Weekends are for the markets, the water and a good book.
profiles.looking_for: Someone patient and independent who understands odd hours. A good sense of humour matters more than anything.
profiles.look: a smiling man with a shaved head and a short beard, in a grey-blue tank top

profiles.training: Hypertrophy block, four days a week.
profiles.about: Numbers by day, weights by night. I keep a training log and a very organised pantry. I love a long dinner, a good documentary and a Sunday swim.
profiles.looking_for: A thoughtful man who likes both a quiet night in and a spontaneous weekend away. Someone who texts back is a plus.
profiles.look: a smiling man with short black hair, in a teal tee

profiles.training: Easy lifting three days a week and long walks on the beach.
profiles.about: I teach maths and coach the school rowing team. I train to stay strong for the next 40 years, not to win anything. I like quiet mornings, big breakfasts and a decent playlist for the drive.
profiles.looking_for: A kind, grounded person who enjoys the outdoors. Whether it turns into friendship or more, I'm happy to find out.
profiles.look: a smiling man with grey hair and a short beard, in a blue tee

profiles.training: Late sessions after service, usually chasing a deadlift PB.
profiles.about: I work nights in a busy kitchen, so my gym time is late and quiet. I cook for friends whenever I get the chance. I'm easygoing, a bit cheeky and always hungry.
profiles.looking_for: Someone relaxed who's up for a late supper or a lazy brunch. Good company and good food is all I need.
profiles.look: a smiling man with blond hair, in an orange tank top

profiles.training: Powerlifting, with a meet twice a year.
profiles.about: I build bridges by day and chase heavy singles by night. I'm close with my family and I'd like to start my own. I take training seriously and everything else a little less so.
profiles.looking_for: A warm, driven woman who wants a family and a full life. Shared values and a shared love of food would be ideal.
profiles.look: a smiling man with short black hair and a neat beard, in a white tank top

profiles.training: Surf at dawn, weights at lunch.
profiles.about: Divorced, relaxed and very sunburnt. I run a small building crew and I'm home most nights by five. My kids stay with me every second weekend and they're the best part of my life.
profiles.looking_for: A genuine, easygoing woman who likes the ocean and a slow Sunday. Kids are welcome, and so is a bad dad joke.
profiles.look: a smiling man with ginger hair and a short beard, in a blue tank top

profiles.training: Lower-body focus: squats, hip thrusts and lunges.
profiles.about: I teach a class of seven-year-olds, so I'm good at patience and very good at snacks. Leg day is my favourite day. After a session you'll find me at the beach with a coffee and a book.
profiles.looking_for: Someone warm and genuine who's up for a sunset swim and a long chat. Bonus points if you can carry the shopping.
profiles.look: a smiling woman with a long ponytail, in an orange top

profiles.training: Pilates and strength work, four days a week.
profiles.about: I design apps for a living and I'm picky about details. I lift to feel strong and do pilates to stay in one piece. I'm happiest with a sketchbook, a flat white and a gym playlist.
profiles.looking_for: Someone creative and kind, of any gender. A new friend or a first date works for me.
profiles.look: a smiling woman with long dark hair, in a teal top

profiles.training: Group strength class at 6 am, then a walk on the beach.
profiles.about: I like an early alarm and a late dinner. My friends call me the planner, and I'm usually the one with the spare hair tie. I'd love to meet someone I can build something lasting with.
profiles.looking_for: A steady, funny person who knows what he wants. Someone who's good with my friends and my very loud family.
profiles.look: a smiling woman with a blonde bob, in a coral top

profiles.training: Gym between night shifts, mostly upper body and core.
profiles.about: I work nights on a busy ward, so I'm tired, funny and always up for good food. I train to blow off steam and I love a spontaneous plan. Give me a playlist and I'll be fine.
profiles.looking_for: Someone easygoing who can keep up with an odd schedule. I'd like to keep things light and see where it goes.
profiles.look: a smiling woman with braids, in a white top

profiles.training: Strength training three days a week and ocean swims.
profiles.about: I spend my days reading small print, so my free time is wide open spaces. I swim most mornings, lift on the other days and cook a lot on Sundays. I'm direct, loyal and a bit of a bookworm.
profiles.looking_for: A confident, kind man who is ready for something real. I'd like a partner for travel, dinners and the occasional dawn swim.
profiles.look: a smiling woman with auburn hair in a bun, in a denim-blue top

profiles.training: Powerlifting with a little bodybuilding on the side.
profiles.about: I look after animals all day, and I'm told I'm a lot like one of them: loyal, a bit silly and always hungry. I have a rescue dog called Biscuit who comes to every park meet-up.
profiles.looking_for: A kind, funny woman who loves animals and a good laugh. Dog walks, gym dates and slow dinners all sound good.
profiles.look: a smiling woman with a short pixie cut, in a coral top

profiles.training: Boxing and conditioning, four days a week.
profiles.about: I design houses for a living and I box to switch off. I love a long lunch, a good view and a bit of banter. I'm close to my whanau and I'd like a partner who is too.
profiles.looking_for: Someone warm and grounded who laughs easily. Friendship first is welcome if it leads somewhere good.
profiles.look: a smiling woman with long wavy dark hair, in a teal top

profiles.training: Strength sessions in the afternoon, boxing on Fridays.
profiles.about: I pour drinks at night and train people in the morning, so I live on very little sleep and a lot of iced coffee. I'm sociable, silly and happiest in a group. Tell me your best gym story.
profiles.looking_for: Someone playful and easy to be around, of any gender. I'm keen on good company and good times.
profiles.look: a smiling woman with a high ponytail, in an olive top

profiles.training: Morning cardio, then a machine circuit.
profiles.about: I run a busy pharmacy and I like things done properly. I train before work so my evenings stay free for cooking and family. I'm warm, practical and a very good listener.
profiles.looking_for: A mature, kind man who's ready to share a home and a future. Someone who enjoys a big table of food and loud company.
profiles.look: a smiling woman with dark wavy hair, in a coral top

profiles.training: Olympic lifting club twice a week, plus mobility work.
profiles.about: I run events, so I'm calm when everything is on fire. Olympic lifting taught me patience and how to laugh at a missed lift. Weekends are for the farmers market, long lunches and a good film.
profiles.looking_for: A thoughtful man with a good sense of humour who likes a plan and a surprise. Someone who'll happily cheer from the sidelines.
profiles.look: a smiling woman with a blonde ponytail, in an orange top
